_note: Ukrainian; see topbar.json and docs/translating.md. The Bibles window (search, Install from File…, Done, each Bible's line), the sheet asking what a Bible file is, the Bible view's Options panel (Параметри), installing, downloading and reading Bibles, and their errors and notices. Bible names, short names, references and Bible text are content and never translated; the window names each language in itself, then in Ukrainian. The Trash is Смітник, as Apple's Ukrainian names it. Headings drawn in capitals in English (EACH SLIDE SHOWS, INSTALLED, AVAILABLE, PREVIEW) are in capitals here too.
